title: Pakistan's NCCIA says it caught a Karachi gang that phoned elderly people in a fraud scheme and recovered cash
date_note: Express's page is dated 25 November and does not state the day of the arrests.
geo_basis: Karachi, where the gang was reported caught; city centre coordinates
summary: Express (Urdu) reports that the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) caught a cyber fraud gang of three friends in Karachi, as announced at a press conference by Additional Director Shahzad Akbar. According to the report, the gang used data obtained from companies to phone elderly people and lure them into schemes, and cash was recovered from a car.
plain: Pakistan's cybercrime agency says it caught a Karachi gang of three friends who phoned elderly people using data from companies, and recovered cash from a car, Express reports.
exec: Pakistan's cybercrime agency announced a fraud-gang arrest in Karachi; Express reports the gang targeted elderly people by phone.

validation.note: One publisher (Express Urdu) relaying an NCCIA press conference; no NCCIA page or second outlet was read.
